title: Rav Menashya bar Gada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that he also received teachings from Rav Huna: Sukkah 13b has both Rabbi Abba and Rav Menashya bar Gada reporting Rav Huna. In Menachot 17a Rav Menashya sits before Abaye and reports Rav Chisda. Abaye asks, “Did my master”—Rav Chisda—“say it in Rav’s name?” He answers yes. In 89b there he challenges Rabbi Yohanan’s statement, followed by Abaye’s answer.
Horayot 12a has him explaining the anointing shape “like a ki” as like a Greek kaph.

In Keritot 27a he asks whether atonement may be obtained with accumulated fifth-payments. He earned his livelihood raising other people’s animals. Bava Metzia 69a relates that Rav Menashya bar Gada took his half and half his partner’s half. He came before Abaye, who asked, “Who divided it for you?” etc.

notes.text: The checked Horayot spells out “Greek kaph,” while Hyman’s letter-label is כ״פ. The fifth-payments question concerns accumulated additional payments, not bonds or benefactors; the supplied בכונים differs from the checked בכינוס.
